Definition: irregular comparative of G3173; larger (literally or figuratively, specially, in age):--elder, greater(-est), more.
BiblicalUsage: Meizon is the comparative word for greater, and 2 Peter 2:11 uses it of angels, who are greater in power and might than the false teachers they refuse to accuse. Even beings that strong hold back where God has not given them leave to speak.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe strength that restrains itself is the mark of those who know their place before God.
